scenario: [LTIM.4.2.3]: `d + dur` and `d - dur` are the `Date` `dur` / 86 400 · 10⁹ days after or before `d`, exactly. One Visit on 2024-02-29 (day 19782), a leap day. Rule `plus` logs `(v.due + 1_d)::String`, 2024-03-01, and rule `minus` logs `(v.due - 7_d)::String`, 2024-02-22. A `Date` is its day count and a `Duration` its nanoseconds ([RDSC.5.5.8]), so a lowering to plain Int `+` and `-` adds 86 400 · 10⁹ to a day count, lands far outside the Date range, and logs neither date. PATH PINNED: `dsc.rete`'s `rlow_6_1_5_date_arith` (RLOW.6.1.5) lowering to FN_DATE_ADD_DURATION and FN_DATE_SUB_DURATION, and the two builtins in libds (`rete/adapters.c`, `date_shift`) and Mercury (`ds.eval.ltim_4_2_3_date_shift`).
rules_ds:
schema Visit scope logical:
    id: Int key
    due: Date mutable

rule plus:
    Visit v
->
    let a = (v.due + 1_d)::String
    log info "plus {a}"

rule minus:
    Visit v
->
    let b = (v.due - 7_d)::String
    log info "minus {b}"
